usd_reason: The US dollar is stable due to mixed signals from Fed officials on interest rates
gold_reason: Gold prices may rise as a safe-haven asset due to ongoing global uncertainties

lead_story: The recent de-escalation in Iran has led to a plunge in oil prices, which in turn has caused US Treasury yields to fall. The US Federal Reserve is still considering rate hikes to address inflation. The joint US and Japan action to prop up the yen has also added to the current economic stability.
